responsibility: This file recognizes and expands D compiler intrinsics. It matches frontend function declarations against the intrinsic table from `intrinsics.def`, marks matching symbols with intrinsic metadata and builtin/CTFE properties, validates constraints, and lowers intrinsic call expressions either to direct GCC builtins or to custom tree expansions for operations such as bit operations, checked arithmetic, volatile/unaligned memory access, varargs helpers, and vector shuffle/convert/blend primitives.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file that matches D declarations against the intrinsic table and expands intrinsic calls into builtins or custom trees; intrinsics.def, by contrast, is only the declarative master list of intrinsic names, modules, signature encodings, enum codes, and builtin mappings.
